static_traits.name: 杨佩彤
static_traits.family_status: Lives with mother，关系亲密，可在遇到困难时与其沟通
static_traits.medical_history: without显著躯体疾病；without既往类似心理问题与治疗史
static_traits.language_features: Clear expression, able to concretely describe triggering situations and automatic thoughts; fairly good cooperation; somewhat negative tone, accompanied by guilt and self-criticism

basic_info.main_problem: I feel that I am wasting my time on hobbies such as going to concerts and collecting stamps. This view leads me to feel guilt and self-criticism.
basic_info.core_demands: I decided to seek counseling because these feelings of guilt and self-criticism have begun to affect my mood and my enjoyment of important activities.
growth_experiences: 大约六个月前，与一位朋友的对话对其影响显著：朋友批评其爱好“have not生产力”，并嘲讽集邮“是老年人才做的事”。此后，每逢周末准备去演唱会或从事集邮活动时，便出现强烈的内疚与自我批评，逐渐难以从爱好中获得快乐。
与Mother关系亲密、同住。遇到困难会与Mother沟通，但在本议题上感到“not yet被理解”，因此情绪缓解有限。

core_beliefs: 我的价值取决于是否在做‘有用/有产出’的事
享受与休闲等于浪费时间

special_situations.event: 周末准备去听演唱会或实际参加演唱会
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果一件事not能直接提升not yet来或带来明确产出，那就是have not价值的
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 试图劝阻自己减少参与或用理性说服自己not要去，以避免内疚
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 我在浪费时间，我应该去做更有意义的事

special_situations.event: 想起朋友对其爱好的批评，或谈到‘是否有生产力’的话题
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 他人的评价决定我的行为是否有价值
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 通过自我批评来约束自己，Repression兴趣以符合他人标准
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 她觉得我not够上进，那我一定是not务正业

special_situations.event: 进行集邮时只注意到其‘have not实际产出’的一面
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 活动若have not可见成果或效率，就等同浪费
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 尝试理性列举利弊，但反复聚焦于负面证据
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 这些活动一点用都have not

special_situations.event: 回想过去几次演唱会与休闲经历
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果某次被认为‘not够有用’，那此类活动一概都是浪费
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 给自己贴上“浪费时间”的标签以逼迫改变行为

core_conflict.wish: Longs, while being recognized by others as 'valuable/productive', to still enjoy personal interests and relaxation at ease
core_conflict.fear: 害怕被评价为“not务正业/without用”，从而被negate或看not起
defense_goal: 通过自我批评与Repression兴趣来避免被指责
以理性化方式讨论‘生产力/价值’，以降低被negate时的Anxiety

object_relations.self_representation: 需要用‘有用/有产出’证明自己的not安自我
object_relations.object_representation: 带有批评与评判的他人（朋友/外界）

object_relations.self_representation: 渴望被理解却感到without助的自我

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: 当他人质疑其爱好的“生产力”，或咨询情境聚焦于价值/效率时
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: 对方在negate我，如果我享受爱好就会被看not起
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Talks about 'efficiency/output' using objective analysis and data-based language, downplays emotional wording, tone is restrained and organized, avoiding going into subjective feelings.

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: 临近周末准备从事爱好时出现强烈内疚与自责
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: 如果我去享受爱好，就会失败或被认为not思进取
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: use苛责、自贬式语句（如“我在浪费时间”），语气严厉，主动放弃或减少爱好行为以缓解Anxiety。

manifestations: 开始质疑爱好的价值，认为去演唱会与集邮“have not意义/have not产出”
难以承认享乐与放松本身的价值，怀疑其人生意义
outcomes: 快感缺失与Reduced interest（对原本喜欢的活动not再享受）

manifestations: 在‘Freedom享受’与‘对自我负责的生产性’之间感到冲突
他人标准内化后，自我选择空间被压缩
outcomes: 以自我苛责方式抑制兴趣，导致心理张力与内耗

contact_model.definition: The individual takes in external rules and expectations without digesting them, treating them as their own standards or absolute truths, corresponding to 'rejection'.
manifestations: 反复use“我应该做有意义的事”来评判自己
朋友的批评在脑海中反复回放，并被当作评判自身的标准

contact_model.definition: The individual has a poor capacity for self-reflection and introspection, with excessive self-restriction and self-blame, and is overly cautious about contact, corresponding to 'autonomy'.
manifestations: 过度自我批评，担心爱好是否‘有用’
在谈及爱好时明显谨慎，倾向用自我责备来约束行为

positive_force: 与Mother关系较为亲密，具备基础情感支持的资源
能觉察到演唱会等活动曾带来放松与幸福感（对积极体验有记忆）
主动求助并愿意尝试咨询与认知检验（现实检验）
具备一定的理性分析能力，能尝试评估活动利弊
negative_force: 将外界‘生产力’标准内化为自我价值评估准则，依赖外部评价
非黑即白、过度概括与心理过滤等认知偏差Reinforcement内疚
强烈的‘应该’信念导致自我苛责与回避享乐
朋友的负向评价反复trigger内疚与Self-denial，破坏活动乐趣

target_behavior.behavior: Strong guilt and self-criticism appear when engaging in hobbies (concerts, stamp collecting), and she tends to reduce or avoid related activities
antecedent: 周末或临近从事爱好时
回想起朋友关于“have not生产力”的批评
与他人谈及是否该参与爱好时
target_behavior.core_reason: 将‘是否有产出/有用’作为唯一价值标准，受朋友批评trigger并内化为自我评价准则
target_behavior.function: 逃避内疚等not适情绪及避免被他人负面评价
target_behavior.consequence: 对原本带来快乐的活动失去兴趣与乐趣，Low mood，Decreased quality of life
